working: I: Acidic KMnO4 oxidises the CH3 group, giving p-nitrobenzoic acid. Its pKa (~3.4) is lower than benzoic acid's (~4.2) because the -NO2 group withdraws electrons by -I and -M effects. So I is correct. II: Sn/HCl reduces -NO2 to -NH2, giving p-toluidine. The CH3 group donates electrons by +I and hyperconjugation, so p-toluidine (pKb ~8.9) is more basic than aniline (pKb ~9.4). So II is correct.
